errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, where the vertical axis displays the categories and the horizontal axis represents the values. The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis shows the categories.
The description invents a category named "Да, между 7-9 бр." which does not exist in the chart. The actual categories are "Не", "Да, между 1-3 бр.", and "Да, между 4-6 бр.".
The description omits the category "Не", which corresponds to the largest bar in the chart (82.2%).
